subject: Buyer pinpointing & procurement timetable — Veridian Health
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.inference>
To: Alex Chen <alex@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 15:24:00 -0800
Subject: Buyer pinpointing & procurement timetable — Veridian Health

Hi Alex — thanks again for a constructive demo today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have alignment:

- What we showed: low-latency model inference (hosted + dedicated options), predictable cost controls, and the rollout path for pilot → production.
- Value we heard: accelerate clinical NLP features without re-architecting inference, predictable token economics, and a compliance-forward private deployment.

Could you confirm three things so we can draft a short mutual action plan?
1) Who is the economic/budget owner that signs off on pilot spend (name + preferred email)?
2) Who in procurement should we include for SOW/terms (you mentioned a procurement alias but I didn’t capture a contact)?
3) Expected procurement timeline for a small pilot (typical cadence: 3–8 weeks?) and any gating items (security questionnaire, SOC2 evidence, legal redlines).

I attached a brief scoping doc that maps the pilot we discussed — scoping-MVP.pdf — so you can share that with the stakeholders. If you prefer, we can offer a short procurement kickoff (30 min) next week to align internal owners.

Thanks — I’ll pause on producing a formal proposal until we have the budget owner and procurement contact.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.inference

Attachment: scoping-MVP.pdf
From: Alex Chen <alex@veridianhealth.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.inference>
Cc: procurement@veridianhealth.com, Mary Johnson <mj@veridianhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Buyer pinpointing & procurement timetable — Veridian Health

Thanks, Logan — great demo, and this doc helps. Quick answers below:

- Budget/Econ owner: Caroline Reyes (Sr. Director, Clinical Apps) — caroline.reyes@veridianhealth.com — she signs off on pilots up to $75k.
- Procurement: procurement@veridianhealth.com (Raj Patel) — I’ve cc’d the alias; Raj will handle SOW/PO.
- Security: Mary Johnson (Head of InfoSec) — mj@veridianhealth.com. She’ll need SOC2 Type II and a short note on data residency for patient-adjacent logs.
- Timeline: For a small pilot we typically run an internal review + PO in 4–6 weeks once the budget owner is looped in. If legal pushes redlines it can add another 2–3 weeks.

I’m attaching the RFP template the team uses so you can see their expected deliverables and SLAs — current-RFP.pdf. Happy to intro Caroline if you think that’s the right next step.

Alex
Product Manager, Innovation
alex@veridianhealth.com

Attachment: current-RFP.pdf

Team — forwarding Alex’s reply (below).

Can you advise on two things before I reach out to Caroline/Raj: 1) recommended pricing posture for a pilot that's low-friction (we want to remove procurement objections, keep pilot < $75k if possible); 2) compliance packet we should share proactively (SOC2 summary, data residency note, and one-pager on private deployment).

Specific asks:
- Priyom: can you produce a one-page pilot pricing option and a short MOP (Milestones/Acceptance) we can include in the intro email?
- Marissa: can you pull the compliance one-pager and the SOC2 summary to attach?

I want to keep this tight — if Caroline is the signatory, we should email her with a 2-sentence ask + a single attachment that outlines scope, cost, and timeline.

Thanks — looping you both so we can move fast.

--

Quick notes — good positioning. A few tactical suggestions:

- Pricing: offer a two-option pilot (recommended):
  1) Lightweight pilot (recommended for faster PO): $25k fixed, 6-week scope, success criteria = 3 production-quality inference endpoints + throughput test.
  2) Pilot-to-PO path: $50k refundable credit toward a committed annual capacity contract if they convert within 60 days.

- Compliance packet: attach SOC2 Type II summary, data residency note, and a 1-pager on Redwood Private deployment. I’ve uploaded the pricing matrix internally (pricing-matrix-v2.xlsx) — use the numbers in column C for pilot skews.
- Intro approach: Email Caroline with a 2-line ask + attached scoping-MVP.pdf + pilot option (one-pager). Copy Raj and Mary; request a 30-min procurement kickoff.

I can draft the pricing one-pager and the PAP (pilot acceptance plan) — will share a draft by EOD.

— Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan@redwood.inference>
To: Caroline Reyes <caroline.reyes@veridianhealth.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex@veridianhealth.com>, Raj Patel <procurement@veridianhealth.com>, Mary Johnson <mj@veridianhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 17 Jan 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Buyer pinpointing & procurement timetable — Veridian Health

Hi Caroline — Alex suggested you’d be the right person to confirm budget for the pilot. Quick note: we’d love to run a lightweight pilot that validates the integration and latency/throughput in your environment.

Ask: would you be willing to review a one-page pilot scope + two pricing options and either: 1) approve the pilot (up to $25k) or 2) point me to the person who signs for pilot spend?

We’d also like to propose a 30-minute procurement kickoff with Raj and Mary to align on the SOW and security checklist. Proposed times (PST): Wed Jan 19, 11:00–11:30; Thu Jan 20, 09:30–10:00. If those don’t work, happy to work around your calendar.

We’ll share the SOC2 summary and a short Redwood Private note ahead of the call. If you prefer, I can send the two-option one-pager now — would a follow-up email with attachments be best or should I drop the packet into the procurement alias?

Thanks for the help — copying Alex, Raj, Mary, Marissa and Priyom to make introductions and keep things transparent.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
logan@redwood.inference

Attachments to follow: scoping-MVP.pdf, pilot-pricing-onepager.pdf
